id: ISS-0950
title: "Catalog service endpoint_url is not URL-validated at registration/publish time (decision 0027 gap)"
discovered_by: SECURITY-REVIEWER
discovered_in_run: WF03-ISS0917-20261001 (filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-10-01T14:06:29Z"
severity: MINOR
owner: "ELIXIR-DEV"
description: >
  Found by SECURITY-REVIEWER in WF03-ISS0917-20261001. POST /service-catalog and publish do no
  UrlValidator check on endpoint_url; the only control is the dispatch-time INV-9 gate in
  ServiceTaskDispatcher.http_transport/3. ISS-0917's fix makes catalog endpoints reachable by the
  dispatcher for the first time, so add fast-feedback syntactic validation (https scheme, host not
  private/loopback literal) at register/publish time in Letflow.ServiceCatalog /
  Routers.AdminServices. Defense in depth; dispatch gate stays binding. Severity MINOR (hardening).
  Owner ELIXIR-DEV (via CODE-DESIGNER).
affected_files:
  - lib/letflow/service_catalog.ex
  - lib/letflow/routers/admin_services.ex
queue_ref: Q-921  # queue issue_ref ISS-0921 collides with an existing local file; local filename ISS-0950
github_ref: GH-2095
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 2 FIX DESIGN. Read the step-01 diagnosis (result.summary in handoffs/WF03-ISS0950-20261001/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json) and produce a design artefact at lib/letflow/design/iss0950-catalog-endpoint-url-register-validation.md (design doc only, no implementation code). Stay in the main checkout on branch feature/WF03-ISS0950-20261001. Scope: fast-feedback SYNTACTIC validation of endpoint_url at register/1 and publish/3 (Entry changesets are the natural single choke point; 422 mapping already exists), reusing Letflow.Webhooks.UrlValidator logic WITHOUT DNS resolution (decide: new public no-DNS function on UrlValidator vs stub resolver; justify; DNS must not happen at register time). Rules to decide explicitly: https only; host present; reject private/loopback/link-local/metadata IP literals (reuse the dispatcher blocklist, do not duplicate it); template handling -- endpoint_url is a template rendered with {{variables.KEY}} at activation, so specify exactly how templates are validated (e.g. validate scheme prefix and, if host part contains no template token, host literal; what to do when the host itself is templated; the fixture at test/letflow/engine_catalog_service_task_test.exs:363 registers a bare {{variables.absent}} -- state whether that fixture must change and why that is acceptable or how to avoid breaking it); error shape (changeset error key/message so 422 body is stable); both insert and publish changesets; update/new-version paths if any. Dispatch gate (INV-9) stays binding and unchanged -- state it. Honour decision 0027 and security-invariants.md INV-9. Include: function signatures with @spec, exact list of files to change, exact list of existing tests/fixtures to adjust, and a test matrix (accepted and rejected URLs, templated cases, both write paths, router-level 422 assertion, plus a unit test asserting no DNS lookup happens). Severity MINOR; keep the change small. Complete the handoff per HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md; do not commit (ORCH commits).
acceptance_criteria: Design file exists at lib/letflow/design/iss0950-catalog-endpoint-url-register-validation.md with no implementation code beyond signatures/specs
Template-URL policy fully specified incl. the {{variables.absent}} fixture
Files-to-change and tests-to-adjust lists are exact
Test matrix covers every rejected/accepted class and both write paths
